invariants.text: User.user_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.user_id must reference an existing User.user_id
An order must be associated with a user through the user_id field.
Only users with the role 'administrator' can modify products.
Only users with the role 'administrator' can modify other users' records.
A user can only create orders if they exist in the system.
An order's status must be one of 'pending', 'completed', or 'cancelled'.
A product's price must be a positive number.
A user's email must be unique across all users.
Only users with the role 'normal' can view their own orders.
A product must have a name and a description.
An order must have an order_date that is not in the future.
